Definition: a powder (as easily puffed away), i.e. ashes or dust
BiblicalUsage: Piach is ashes, fine dust that blows away. God told Moses to take handfuls of ashes of the furnace and sprinkle them toward heaven in Exodus 9:8, and in Exodus 9:10 the ashes became boils breaking out on man and beast.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God can turn furnace dust into a plague, and a handful of ashes into a sign Pharaoh could not ignore.
